outcomes_partition: most of the per-M-tile cost is NOT weight traffic: giving every M-tile its own copy barely moved the time. The traffic model is the wrong KIND of model, and the study's negative result about alpha becomes a positive result about the mechanism.
the re-read is real but smaller than the refit says: between the two registered worlds, and the page says so rather than rounding to one.
the refit 0.558 is a traffic fraction after all, measured here without an assumed rate and without a fitted intercept.
the re-read is larger than the refit says: between the two registered worlds, and the page says so rather than rounding to one.
essentially the whole weight set is re-read per extra M-tile. The re-read is real and the traffic model's SHAPE was right even though its coefficient was not identifiable from timing.
